{{Top|leg}}
'''Magnetic grappler boots''' were a type of specialized [[Magnetic boot/Legends|magnetic boot]] utilized by [[Purge trooper]]s, and were designed to protect the wearer against being pulled or pushed by an opponent's [[Force power/Legends|force powers]]. Capable of operating on any surface (including non-metallic), these boots resisted against forced movement of any kind.<ref name="GaW">''[[Galaxy at War]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Unlike other magnetic boots that often stipulate terrain restrictions, Magnetic grappler boots grant a flat +5 to any forced movement, showing that they can be used anywhere.<ref name="GaW" />
